STATS::setmin
       Ensures that the value of a Statistics profile setting is at the most value.

SYNOPSIS
       STATS::setmin PROFILE_NAME FIELD_NAME (VALUE)?

DESCRIPTION
       Ensures that the value of the specified Statistics profile setting (field) is at the most value.

       Syntax

       STATS::setmin   []

	    * Ensures that the value of the specified Statistics profile setting
	      (field) is at the most value.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.2.0 --First introduced the command.
